exercises.name: Magnum Decline Bench Press (Hammer Strength)
exercises.planned: Travel substitute for chest press machine
exercises.weight: 60 lb/arm (45 lb plate/side + 15 lb starting resistance)
exercises.note: Set 1 regular grip 10. Set 2 switched to neutral grip 10. Set 3 10. Plate-loaded Hammer Strength decline press, stickers read 'Starting Resistance 15 lb' so ~60 lb per arm. Good substitute for the chest press machine while traveling.

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press
exercises.note: All reps. Last rep pretty tough but got them all. Held at 40.

exercises.name: Cable Row
exercises.note: Started 130 (this gym's increments differ from home). Got 10, then 8 on set 2. Dropped to 120 for set 3 and got 10 â probably had 1+ more. Attributes the drop-off to 5 days of low protein + machine possibly running heavier here.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Started 115 at this gym. 3x10, last rep tough. Different machine/increments than home.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.note: 15 lb DBs. Got all 3 sets of 15. Last rep very difficult but completed. Consistent with home working weight.

exercises.name: Incline DB Curl
exercises.note: Incline bench. 3x12 at 20 lb. Supersetted with skull crushers.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (EZ-Bar)
exercises.note: 40 lb bar. Set 1 12, set 2 10. Only 2 sets. NOTE: this was OFF the home program due to upper back strain (overhead extension risk) â back must be feeling good. Flag if any tightness.

exercises.name: Core Circuit (2 rounds)
exercises.planned: Hanging knee raise / dead bugs / side plank
exercises.note: Hanging knee raises x10, dead bugs x20, 30-sec planks each side. 2 rounds.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: I did 360 lb on the leg press but the machine said that the sled starting resistance was 167 lb. The sled in my home gym is definitely not as heavy as this sled but just this is probably more accurate so 360 + 167 and I got three sets of ten.

exercises.name: Seated/Lying Leg Curl
exercises.note: I did seated leg curl. The machine immediately felt like it had a higher resistance than my home gym so I started on 60 lb. I got 10 reps then I went to 65 and I got 10 reps. And I got 10 reps on set three.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust (or DB Hip Thrust)
exercises.note: Instead of Smith machine hip thrusts I did deadlifts on a squat lunge plate-loaded Smith machine. I'll send you a picture so you can see what it's like but the starting resistance is 36 lb per arm and then I did 45 lb plates first set, got 10. I got 10 on set two and 13 on set three.
